name: print-social-lime-glass-chat-cards-brand-post-on-dark-ghost-lettering
title: Lime Glass Chat Cards on Ghost Lettering
whatItIs: A stock-vector preview of a dark social post with giant outlined ghost letters of a brand name, a tilted olive-lime glass card with a lime logo tile and the reply 'Don't worry! We'll build your brand from identity to marketing!', a lime CONTACT US label and an outlined website pill.
whatItMeans: Speech-bubble cards turn a service pitch into a conversation, and lime on black is energetic.
techniques: Giant outlined brand letters as a texture
Tilted glass cards used as chat bubbles
Lime logo tile as an avatar
Outlined pill for the website call to action
Lime gradient rising from a corner

vocabulary.definition: Large letters drawn as thin outlines with no fill.
A card styled like a message bubble to deliver a pitch.
A capsule drawn as an outline for a link.
